# RAMpage firmware, vendored

Unmodified copies of `pico_direct.py` (the Pico W weapon and safety firmware) and `pi4_direct.py` (the Pi 4B video sender) from https://github.com/avemath/RAMpage at commit `929c280`. The home page RAMpage tile shows short excerpts cut from these files at build time, so the code on the page is the code that ran on the robot. Update both files together if the repo changes.
